provenance: Stage-2 lane split applying the decision-agent's documented routing rule (detect-vs-hunt by detection feasibility, not severity: low=hunt, medium/high=detect) deterministically from each TTP's Stage-1 detection_feasibility assessment. Partition validated to cover the Stage-1 seed exactly with no overlap/dup; all ids verified present in the CI's bundled ATT&CK dataset.

detection_candidates.rationale: medium — malicious Office attachments are detectable at the mail gateway and via Office child-process/macro telemetry, but the decoy is document content the endpoint only sees on open; targeting Persian-speaking individuals limits enterprise mail-flow visibility
medium — WINWORD.EXE spawning script/child processes and macro-enable events are observable via process-lineage and Office macro telemetry

detection_candidates.technique_name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Visual Basic
detection_candidates.rationale: high — VBA macro execution that writes and launches a PE from the Public folder is detectable via macro/script-block logging, Office child-process creation, and file-write-then-execute correlation

detection_candidates.technique_name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
detection_candidates.rationale: high — creation of an executable named svehost.exe in the Startup folder is directly observable via file-creation monitoring of Startup paths and autoruns baselining; the masquerading name (svehost vs svchost) is a strong watchlist item

detection_candidates.technique_name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Shortcut Modification
detection_candidates.rationale: high — modification of Telegram/Chrome .lnk target paths to chain a secondary executable is detectable via shortcut-file change monitoring and process-lineage showing the browser/messenger launching an unexpected child from a user-writable path
high — bitsadmin.exe command-line execution with job name 'pdj' and BITS-Client operational-log transfer events to unexpected hosts are high-fidelity, actor-specific detections

medium — file downloads following the initial foothold are detectable via proxy/DNS to the C2 domains and file-write telemetry, but HTTP downloads blend with normal traffic absent the specific IOC domains
medium — file names containing the U+202E control character are detectable via filename-scanning heuristics on downloaded/dropped files, but require tooling that inspects for the RTLO codepoint

detection_candidates.technique_name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Resource Name or Location
detection_candidates.rationale: medium — names/icons that mimic legitimate binaries in user-writable locations are detectable via name/path baselining and signature-vs-name/icon mismatch, but need endpoint context

medium — the creation of a screenshot artifact named scr.jpg in the malware working directory is detectable via file-creation monitoring of the implant's repository path; the screen-capture API call itself is low-signal

detection_candidates.technique_name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell
detection_candidates.rationale: medium — cmd.exe /c spawned by the MarkiRAT implant process is detectable via process-lineage (unexpected parent), though cmd.exe use itself is common and needs parent-process context

medium — the fixed URI patterns (/i.php, /ech/echo.php?req=rr, /ech/rite.php) and the '3 LOK 0' response are strong network-signature candidates on proxy/IDS, but require the specific IOCs since the transport is ordinary HTTP
medium — outbound HTTP POST uploads to the /up/uploadx.php endpoint on the C2 domains are detectable via proxy/network telemetry when the IOC domains/URI are known
medium — macro code that decodes a large hex/embedded blob and writes a PE is detectable via script-block/macro content heuristics and drop-then-execute correlation

hunting_candidates.rationale: low — in-memory process enumeration to fingerprint AV leaves little discrete host signal; hunt candidate via API-behavior/EDR sensor telemetry rather than a discrete event
low — process enumeration is ubiquitous and largely benign; only meaningful as a hunt in tight process-lineage context around the implant

hunting_candidates.technique_name: System Location Discovery: System Language Discovery
hunting_candidates.rationale: low — keyboard-layout / locale API queries are common and produce little discrete telemetry; hunt-only signal, valuable mainly as a malware-analysis triage indicator
low — user-mode keystroke hooking is difficult to distinguish behaviorally; hunt candidate via EDR API-hook telemetry and the 'nfo' log-file artifact rather than a reliable log event
low — clipboard reads via native APIs are not reliably logged; hunt-only, best surfaced via EDR behavioral sensors
low — window-title enumeration produces no reliable discrete host event; hunt-only, of value mainly during malware analysis
low — directory enumeration is common and noisy; meaningful only as a hunt within the implant's process-lineage window
low — local file collection resembles normal user activity; better addressed as a hunt over access to sensitive extensions (.kdbx/.gpg/.pkr) and honeytoken files than a reliable real-time detection
